headline: Man Teaches His Goldfish to Play Poker, Wins Neighborhood Tournament
summary: The fish has an incredible poker face and excellent memory for cards.
fullBody: After months of training, Kevin's goldfish 'Bluff' dominated the local poker night. 'He never bluffs... or does he?' said a defeated neighbor. Animal behaviorists are studying the phenomenon while bookies refuse to take bets against aquatic opponents.
